about.metaDescription: How Lukka Place, Kinshasa's property listings platform, works.
about.title: A Platform Built for Kinshasa
about.lead: Agents and private owners submit their properties over WhatsApp. Every listing is structured, verified, then published.
about.body1: Lukka Place is a property listings platform dedicated to Kinshasa. Agents and private owners submit their properties directly over WhatsApp — text or photos — and every listing is structured and then verified before being published on the site.
about.body2: The aim is simple: to give people looking for an apartment, a villa or a plot in Kinshasa one single, up-to-date place where every listing corresponds to a property that is genuinely available — and a direct way to get in touch about a property, with no account and no form.
about.body3: Prices are set in US dollars. The Congolese franc display is an indicative estimate, converted at a dated reference rate that is updated manually, and is never presented as the contractual price.
about.body4: Lukka Place does not provide direct financial brokerage services; the platform facilitates introductions between advertisers and interested parties via listing reference.
